findings.evidence: Roadmap README lines 149–152 requires retained-set semantics together with single-coordinate forms; `rg` finds only `mem_puncture_singleton` and `mem_shorten_singleton`, both specialized to `{i}`, at lines 85 and 97.
findings.fix: Add canonical single-coordinate deletion forms (for example `punctureAt C i := puncture C {i}ᶜ` and `shortenAt C i := shorten C {i}ᶜ`) with membership characterizations and bridges to the set-based operations.
findings.issue: The only “single-coordinate” API retains `{i}`; coding-theoretic puncturing/shortening at one coordinate deletes `i`, which under this PR’s convention means retaining `{i}ᶜ`. This leaves later statements such as puncturing any Golay coordinate without the promised canonical interface.

findings.evidence: Lines 64 and 71 annotate the general membership lemmas `@[simp]`, while the specialized normal forms at lines 85 and 97 have no automation annotation.
findings.fix: Mark both singleton membership equivalences `@[simp]` (and likewise the deletion-form membership lemmas added above).
findings.issue: `mem_puncture_singleton` and `mem_shorten_singleton` are characteristic membership normal forms but lack `@[simp]`, so simplification falls back to the more general existential/forall forms from `mem_puncture` and `mem_shorten`.

summary: The API omits the roadmap’s single-coordinate deletion forms and leaves its singleton characteristic lemmas out of simp normalization.
